rows.source_ko: 해양경찰청 (혁신행정법무담당관), 032-835-2322
rows.text_en: Korea Coast Guard ( Innovation Administration & Legal Affairs Division ), 032-835-2322

rows.source_ko: 제1장 총칙
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 해양경찰청과 그 소속기관에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「해양경찰청과 그 소속기관 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Organization of the Korea Coast Guard and Its Affiliated Agencies and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing levels for auxiliary and advisory agencies and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliary agencies placed under a director pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the Government Organization Act, and advisory agencies equivalent thereto.

rows.source_ko: 제2장 해양경찰청
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Korea Coast Guard

rows.source_ko: 제2조(대변인) 대변인은 서기관 또는 총경으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Spokesperson) The spokesperson shall be appointed as a secretary or a superintendent.

rows.source_ko: 제2조의2(디지털소통팀장) ① 청장 밑에 디지털소통팀장 1명을 둔다. <개정 2026. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 2-2 (Head of Digital Communication Team) ① One Head of Digital Communication Team shall be appointed under the Commissioner. <Amended Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Digital Communication Team shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 디지털소통팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 청장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Digital Communication Team assists the Commissioner in the following matters.

[This Article newly inserted Dec. 31, 2025]
[Title amended Mar. 24, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기획조정관) ① 기획조정관 밑에 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정법무담당관ㆍ인사담당관ㆍ교육훈련담당관ㆍ국제협력담당관 및 인공지능전환팀장을 두며, 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정법무담당관ㆍ인사담당관 및 국제협력담당관은 총경으로, 교육훈련담당관은 서기관 또는 총경으로, 인공지능전환팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ총경 또는 경정으로 보한다. <개정 2020. 2. 4., 2020. 7. 21., 2020. 10. 8., 2021. 1. 14., 2021. 12. 14., 2023. 12. 29., 2024. 3. 26., 2025. 9. 23., 2025. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Planning and Coordination Officer) ① Under the Planning and Coordination Officer, there shall be a Planning and Finance Officer, an Innovation Administration and Legal Affairs Officer, a Personnel Officer, an Education and Training Officer, an International Cooperation Officer, and an Artificial Intelligence Transformation Team Leader. The Planning and Finance Officer, the Innovation Administration and Legal Affairs Officer, the Personnel Officer, and the International Cooperation Officer shall be appointed as Superintendents; the Education and Training Officer shall be appointed as a Senior Officer or Superintendent; and the Artificial Intelligence Transformation Team Leader shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Senior Officer, Computer Science Officer, Superintendent, or Senior Superintendent. <Amended Feb. 4, 2020; Jul. 21, 2020; Oct. 8, 2020; Jan. 14, 2021; Dec. 14, 2021; Dec. 29, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Sep. 23, 2025; Dec. 31, 2025>

rows.text_en: Article 6 (Security Bureau) ① The Security Bureau shall have a Security Operations Division, an Aviation Division, and a Maritime Traffic Control Division; provided that the Heads of the Security Operations Division and the Aviation Division shall be appointed as Senior Superintendents, and the Head of the Maritime Traffic Control Division shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology or Senior Secretary. <Amended Dec. 2, 2019; May 31, 2022; June 1, 2023; Sep. 12, 2023; Dec. 29, 2023>

rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning education and training of maritime and aviation personnel

rows.text_en: 6. Implementation of maritime and aviation safety management measures, institutional improvement, and safety guidance and supervision

rows.source_ko: 2. 해상교통관제 운영에 관한 사항

rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning international exchange and cooperation related to maritime traffic control

rows.source_ko: 9. 해상교통관제 기술개발 정책ㆍ기획에 관한 사항

rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the transfer and utilization of maritime traffic control technology development results

rows.source_ko: 12. 해양사고위험탐지 시스템 활용 및 해상교통관제시스템 등과의 연동에 관한 사항

rows.source_ko: 제7조(구조안전국) ① 구조안전국에 해양안전과ㆍ수색구조과 및 수상레저과를 두며, 각 과장은 총경으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Search and Safety Bureau) ① The Search and Rescue Division, the Water Leisure Division, and the Marine Safety Division shall be established within the Search and Rescue Bureau, and the heads of each division shall be appointed at the rank of Superintendent.

rows.text_en: 1. Planning, guidance, and operation of police substations and branch offices

rows.source_ko: 2. 연안해역 안전점검 및 사고예방 활동
rows.text_en: 2. Coastal Safety Inspections and Accident Prevention Activities

rows.text_en: 7. Guidance and Supervision of Beach Safety Management

rows.source_ko: 8. 해수욕장 안전관리와 관련된 국내외 법령ㆍ제도의 연구 및 개선
rows.text_en: 8. Research and improvement of domestic and international laws and systems related to beach safety management

rows.source_ko: 9. 해수욕장 안전관리 관계기관ㆍ단체 등 협의ㆍ조정

rows.text_en: 12. Operation of the Central Coastal Accident Prevention Council

rows.source_ko: 13. 어선 출입항 신고 업무 지도ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 13. Guidance and Management of Fishing Vessel Entry and Exit Reporting Duties

rows.source_ko: 14. 즉결심판 및 통고처분에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning summary judgments and disposition by notice

rows.source_ko: 15. 그 밖에 국 내 다른 과의 사무에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Other matters not falling under the affairs of other domestic divisions

rows.source_ko: ③ 수색구조과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 5. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Search and Rescue Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended May 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양사고 및 해양재난 대비ㆍ대응
rows.text_en: 1. Preparedness and Response to Maritime Accidents and Disasters

rows.source_ko: 2. 해양사고 수색구조 및 관련 제도의 연구ㆍ개선
rows.text_en: 2. Research and Improvement of Maritime Accident Search and Rescue and Related Systems

rows.source_ko: 3. 해양 사고 및 재난 발생에 대비한 수난대비계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment of a maritime disaster preparedness plan in preparation for maritime accidents and disasters

rows.text_en: 4. Collection and research of technical information related to maritime search and rescue

rows.text_en: 5. International Cooperation and Implementation of Conventions Related to Maritime Search and Rescue

rows.text_en: 7. Operational support, guidance, and supervision of the Central Maritime Special Rescue Unit and the Korea Coast Guard Rescue Team

rows.source_ko: 9. 해양안전 관련 민ㆍ관ㆍ군 구조 협력 및 합동 구조훈련에 관한 사항

rows.source_ko: 10. 주변국 등 국가 간 수색구조 합동훈련 지도ㆍ조정에 관한 사항

rows.source_ko: 11. 수상구조사 자격 및 제도 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the qualifications and operation of the water rescue specialist system

rows.source_ko: ④ 수상레저과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2026. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Water Leisure Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 수상ㆍ수중레저활동 안전관리에 관한 정책의 수립ㆍ조정 및 지도

rows.text_en: 2. Creation and Promotion of a Safety Culture for Water and Underwater Leisure

rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the management of organizations related to water and underwater leisure safety and the establishment of a public-private cooperation system

The heads of the Investigation Planning Division, the Investigation Review Division, and the Criminal Division shall be appointed as Senior Superintendents, and the heads of the Forensic Science Team and the Serious Crime Investigation Team shall be appointed as Superintendents. <Amended Dec. 29, 2023>

rows.text_en: 1. Receipt and processing of civil investigation cases (complaints, accusations, petitions, appeals)

rows.source_ko: 3. 수사 관련 법무지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning legal support related to investigations

rows.source_ko: 4. 유치장 및 유치인 관리 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Management of detention facilities and detainees

rows.source_ko: 5. 영장심사ㆍ수사심사에 관한 제도ㆍ정책의 수립
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of systems and policies regarding warrant review and investigation review

rows.source_ko: 6. 소속기관의 영장심사관 및 수사심사관에 대한 지도ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 6. Guidance and management of warrant review officers and investigation review officers of affiliated institutions

rows.source_ko: 7. 사건관계인 인권보호정책의 수립ㆍ지도 및 수사경찰의 청렴도 평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the establishment and guidance of human rights protection policies for persons involved in a case and the evaluation of the integrity of investigative police

rows.text_en: 1. Planning, guidance, and coordination regarding criminal affairs

rows.text_en: 2. Collection, Management, and Guidance of Criminal Records

rows.text_en: 3. Command and supervision of investigations into violent crimes such as murder, robbery, theft, and assault

rows.source_ko: 5. 마약사범에 관한 정보의 처리, 수사 지휘 및 감독

rows.text_en: 6. Direction and supervision of investigations regarding metropolitan crimes

rows.text_en: 7. Command and supervision of investigations regarding serious crimes endangering national security

rows.text_en: 8. Direction and supervision of investigations into crimes likely to have a serious impact on social order, such as corruption and white-collar crimes

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 과학수사팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2020. 7. 21., 2021. 1. 14.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Forensic Science Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Jul. 21, 2020; Jan. 14, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 과학수사 업무에 관한 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, guidance, and coordination of forensic science operations

rows.source_ko: 3. 과학수사 장비 및 기법에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning forensic science equipment and techniques

rows.source_ko: 4. 범죄 감식 및 증거 분석
rows.text_en: 4. Criminal Forensics and Evidence Analysis

rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Serious Crime Investigation Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Dec. 29, 2023; May 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 중요 범죄첩보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 기획ㆍ조정ㆍ지도ㆍ통제에 관한 사항

rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Information Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 정보업무에 관한 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, guidance, and coordination regarding information affairs

rows.text_en: Article 20 (Regional Coast Guard Headquarters) ① Departments and divisions shall be established within each Regional Coast Guard Headquarters in accordance with the classifications in the following subparagraphs, and an Audit and Hearing Officer and a Head of the General Situation Room shall be placed under the Head of the Regional Coast Guard Headquarters. However, the Central, West Sea, and South Sea Regional Coast Guard Headquarters shall place a Head of the General Situation Room under the Head of the Safety Management Department. <Amended Dec. 2, 2019; Jan. 14, 2021; Feb. 25, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 2. 중부ㆍ서해 및 남해지방해양경찰청: 안전총괄부 및 기획운영과. 이 경우 안전총괄부에 경비과ㆍ구조안전과ㆍ수사과ㆍ정보외사과 및 해양오염방제과를 둔다.
rows.text_en: 2. Central, West Sea and South Sea Regional Coast Guard Headquarters: Safety Management Department and Planning and Operations Division. In this case, the Safety Management Department shall have the Security Division, Rescue and Safety Division, Investigation Division, Information and Foreign Affairs Division, and Marine Pollution Control Division.

rows.text_en: Article 22 (General Situation Room) The Head of the General Situation Room assists the Head of the Regional Coast Guard Headquarters with respect to the following matters. Provided, however, that the Heads of the General Situation Rooms of the Central, West Sea, and South Sea Regional Coast Guard Headquarters assist the Director General of Safety Management. <Amended Dec. 2, 2019; Feb. 25, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제28조의2(정보외사과) 정보외사과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: Article 28-2 (Information and Foreign Affairs Division) The Head of the Information and Foreign Affairs Division shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 정보업무에 관한 지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Guidance and coordination regarding information operations

rows.source_ko: 2. 공공안녕에 대한 위험의 예방과 대응을 위한 정보의 수집ㆍ종합ㆍ분석ㆍ작성 및 배포
rows.text_en: 2. Collection, synthesis, analysis, compilation, and distribution of information for the prevention and response to risks to public safety

rows.source_ko: 3. 정책정보의 수집ㆍ종합ㆍ분석ㆍ작성 및 배포
rows.text_en: 3. Collection, synthesis, analysis, compilation, and distribution of policy information

rows.source_ko: 4. 해상 집회ㆍ시위 등 집단사태의 관리에 관한 지도ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Guidance and coordination regarding the management of collective situations, such as maritime assemblies and demonstrations

rows.source_ko: 5. 외사업무에 관한 지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 5. Guidance and coordination regarding foreign affairs

rows.source_ko: 6. 외사정보의 수집ㆍ종합ㆍ분석ㆍ작성 및 배포
rows.text_en: 6. Collection, synthesis, analysis, compilation, and distribution of foreign affairs information

rows.source_ko: 7. 해양치안 관련 국제교류ㆍ협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning international exchange and cooperation related to maritime security

rows.source_ko: 8. 보안업무에 관한 지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 8. Guidance and coordination regarding security operations

rows.source_ko: 9. 보안정보의 수집ㆍ종합ㆍ분석ㆍ작성 및 배포
rows.text_en: 9. Collection, Synthesis, Analysis, Compilation, and Distribution of Security Information

rows.source_ko: 10. 소속 해양경찰서의 정보ㆍ외사ㆍ보안 업무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning intelligence, foreign affairs, and security affairs of the affiliated Coast Guard Station
[This Article Newly Inserted Jan. 14, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제29조(해양오염방제과) 해양오염방제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: Article 29 (Marine Pollution Control Division) The Head of the Marine Pollution Control Division shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양오염 방제조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning marine pollution control measures

rows.source_ko: 2. 지역방제대책본부의 설치ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and Operation of Regional Disaster Response Headquarters

rows.source_ko: 3. 해양오염방제업ㆍ유창청소업의 등록 및 지도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the registration and supervision of marine pollution control and oil tank cleaning businesses

rows.source_ko: 4. 해양시설오염비상계획서 검인 및 안전점검의 지도
rows.text_en: 4. Verification of Marine Facility Pollution Emergency Plans and Guidance on Safety Inspections

rows.source_ko: 5. 지역해양오염방제대책협의회의 구성ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 5. Composition and Operation of the Regional Marine Pollution Control Measures Council

rows.source_ko: 6. 지역긴급방제실행계획의 수립 및 실행
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and Implementation of Regional Emergency Disaster Response Plan

rows.source_ko: 7. 오염물질 해양배출신고의 처리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the processing of reports on the marine discharge of pollutants

rows.source_ko: 8. 방제비용에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning pest control costs

rows.source_ko: 9. 해양오염방지 및 방제 교육ㆍ훈련에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning education and training for marine pollution prevention and response

rows.source_ko: 10. 방제장비ㆍ자재 및 약제의 긴급동원 및 보급ㆍ지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the emergency mobilization, supply, and support of pest control equipment, materials, and chemicals

rows.source_ko: 11. 기름 및 유해화학물질 사고 대비ㆍ대응에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning preparedness and response to oil and hazardous chemical accidents

rows.source_ko: 12. 방제 관련 관할해역의 특성정보ㆍ자료 수집 및 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the collection and management of characteristic information and data of jurisdictional waters related to pollution control

rows.source_ko: 13. 해양오염방지를 위한 예방활동 및 지도ㆍ점검
rows.text_en: 13. Preventive activities and guidance/inspection for the prevention of marine pollution

rows.source_ko: 14. 오염물질의 해양배출 행위에 대한 조사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning the investigation of marine discharge activities

rows.source_ko: 15. 해양오염 예방 및 방제관련 전산시스템 운용
rows.text_en: 15. Operation of computerized systems related to marine pollution prevention and control

rows.source_ko: 16. 해양환경감시원의 직무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 16. Matters concerning the duties of marine environmental monitors

rows.source_ko: 17. 선박해체 해양오염방지작업계획의 신고에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Matters concerning the reporting of marine pollution prevention work plans for ship dismantling

rows.source_ko: 18. 오염물질의 감식ㆍ분석 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 18. Matters concerning the identification and analysis, etc. of pollutants

rows.source_ko: 19. 해양오염방지를 위한 구난조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 19. Matters concerning rescue measures for the prevention of marine pollution

rows.source_ko: 제30조(해양경찰서) ① 해양경찰서에 기획운영과ㆍ경비구조과ㆍ해양안전과ㆍ수사과ㆍ정보외사과ㆍ해양오염방제과 및 장비관리과를 둔다. 다만, 인천해양경찰서 및 동해해양경찰서에는 기획운영과ㆍ경비구조과ㆍ해양안전과ㆍ수사과ㆍ정보외사과ㆍ해양오염방제과ㆍ장비관리과 및 보안팀을 두고, 태안해양경찰서ㆍ완도해양경찰서ㆍ울산해양경찰서ㆍ포항해양경찰서ㆍ속초해양경찰서ㆍ보령해양경찰서ㆍ부안해양경찰서ㆍ울진해양경찰서 및 사천해양경찰서에는 기획운영과ㆍ경비구조과ㆍ해양안전과ㆍ수사과ㆍ정보외사과ㆍ해양오염방제과 및 장비관리운영팀을 두며, 강릉해양경찰서에는 기획운영과ㆍ경비구조과ㆍ해양안전방제과ㆍ수사정보과 및 장비관리운영팀을 둔다. <개정 2021. 2. 25., 2022. 2. 22., 2025. 2. 25., 2025. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 30 (Coast Guard Stations) ① Coast Guard stations shall have the Planning and Operations Division, Security and Rescue Division, Maritime Safety Division, Investigation Division, Intelligence and Foreign Affairs Division, Marine Pollution Control Division, and Equipment Management Division. However, Incheon Coast Guard Station and Donghae Coast Guard Station shall have the Planning and Operations Division, Security and Rescue Division, Maritime Safety Division, Investigation Division, Intelligence and Foreign Affairs Division, Marine Pollution Control Division, Equipment Management Division, and Security Team; Taean Coast Guard Station, Wando Coast Guard Station, Ulsan Coast Guard Station, Pohang Coast Guard Station, Sokcho Coast Guard Station, Boryeong Coast Guard Station, Buan Coast Guard Station, Uljin Coast Guard Station, and Sacheon Coast Guard Station shall have the Planning and Operations Division, Security and Rescue Division, Maritime Safety Division, Investigation Division, Intelligence and Foreign Affairs Division, Marine Pollution Control Division, and Equipment Management and Operation Team; and Gangneung Coast Guard Station shall have the Planning and Operations Division, Security and Rescue Division, Marine Safety and Pollution Control Division, Investigation and Intelligence Division, and Equipment Management and Operation Team. <Amended Feb. 25, 2021; Feb. 22, 2022; Feb. 25, 2025; Dec. 31, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 각 과장 및 팀장은 경정 또는 경감으로 보한다. 다만, 해양오염방제과장은 공업사무관ㆍ해양수산사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ방재안전사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2017. 11. 28., 2021. 2. 25., 2023. 9. 12.>
rows.text_en: ② Each Division Head and Team Leader shall be appointed at the rank of Senior Superintendent or Senior Superintendent. However, the Head of the Marine Pollution Control Division shall be appointed as an Industrial Officer, Marine and Fisheries Officer, Health Officer, Environmental Officer, or Disaster Prevention and Safety Officer. <Amended Nov. 28, 2017; Feb. 25, 2021; Sep. 12, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 각 과장 및 팀장의 분장사무는 해양경찰청장이 정하는 기준에 따라 지방해양경찰청장이 정한다. <개정 2021. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ The assigned duties of each Division Head and Team Leader shall be determined by the Head of the Regional Coast Guard in accordance with the standards established by the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard. <Amended Feb. 25, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제31조(파출소 및 출장소의 설치기준) 해양경찰서장의 소관 사무를 분장하기 위하여 해양경찰서장 소속으로 파출소를 두되, 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 출장소를 둘 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 31 (Standards for Establishment of Police Substations and Branch Offices) Police substations shall be established under the jurisdiction of the Head of the Maritime Police Station to distribute the duties under the jurisdiction of the Head of the Maritime Police Station; however, branch offices may be established in any of the following cases:

rows.source_ko: 1. 도서, 농ㆍ어촌 벽지 등 교통ㆍ지리적 원격지로 인접 해양경찰관서에서의 출동이 용이하지 아니한 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where dispatch from adjacent Coast Guard stations is difficult due to transportation and geographical remote areas, such as islands, rural and fishing villages.

rows.source_ko: 2. 관할구역에 국가중요시설 등 특별한 경계가 요구되는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where special boundaries are required within the jurisdiction, such as for critical national facilities.

rows.source_ko: 3. 휴전선 인근 등 보안상 취약지역을 관할하는 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where jurisdiction is exercised over security-vulnerable areas, such as near the Demilitarized Zone.

rows.source_ko: 4. 제1호부터 제3호까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 치안수요가 특수하여 파출소를 운영하는 것이 적당하지 아니한 경우
rows.text_en: 4. Cases where, in addition to the matters prescribed in Subparagraphs 1 through 3, it is not appropriate to operate a police substation due to special public security demands.

rows.source_ko: 제32조(해상교통관제센터) ① 지방해양경찰청장 소속하에 두는 해상교통관제센터의 명칭 및 위치는 별표 3과 같다. <개정 2022. 1. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 32 (Maritime Traffic Control Centers) ① The names and locations of maritime traffic control centers established under the jurisdiction of the Commissioners of Regional Coast Guardsshall be as set forth in Attached Table 3. <Amended Jan. 18, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ② 해상교통관제센터장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ해양수산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 경정으로 보한다. <개정 2022. 1. 18., 2023. 9. 12.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Maritime Traffic Control Center shall be appointed from among the Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Officer for Maritime Affairs and Fisheries, Officer for Broadcasting and Telecommunications, or Superintendent. <Amended Jan. 18, 2022; Sep. 12, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 해상교통관제센터장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Maritime Traffic Control Center shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 해상교통관제센터의 설치ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of the Maritime Traffic Control Center

rows.source_ko: 2. 해상교통관제 시설 설치 및 관리ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the installation, management, and operation of maritime traffic control facilities

rows.source_ko: 3. 해상교통관제절차 위반사항의 처리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the handling of violations of maritime traffic control procedures

rows.source_ko: 4. 항만운영에 관한 정보 제공에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the provision of information regarding port operations

rows.source_ko: 5. 해상교통관제센터 직원 복무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the service of Maritime Traffic Control Center staff

rows.source_ko: 6. 해상교통관제업무 절차 홍보ㆍ안전교육 및 지도ㆍ점검에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the promotion, safety education, guidance, and inspection of maritime traffic control procedures

rows.source_ko: 7. 해상교통관제센터의 대내외 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning internal and external cooperation of the Maritime Traffic Control Center

rows.source_ko: 제6장 해양경찰정비창
rows.text_en: Chapter 6 Coast Guard Maintenance Depot

rows.source_ko: 제33조(창장) ① 해양경찰정비창(이하 “정비창”이라 한다)에 창장 1인을 두되, 창장은 임기제공무원으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 33 (Director) ① One Director shall be appointed to the Korea Coast Guard Maintenance Depot (hereinafter referred to as the “Maintenance Depot”), and the Director shall be appointed as a fixed-term public official.

rows.source_ko: ② 창장은 해양경찰정비창의 사무를 총괄하고, 소속 공무원을 지휘 감독한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Director oversees the affairs of the Korea Coast Guard Maintenance Depot and directs and supervises the officials under its jurisdiction.

rows.source_ko: 제7장 공무원의 정원
rows.text_en: Chapter 7 Staffing Levels of Public Officials

rows.source_ko: 제34조(해양경찰청에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 해양경찰청에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 4와 같다. 다만, 「해양경찰청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제35조제1항 단서에 따라 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 4의2와 같으며, 별표 4의2의 정원 중 26명(6급 3명, 7급 6명, 9급 17명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <개정 2019. 8. 19., 2020. 2. 4., 2020. 7. 21., 2020. 10. 8., 2021. 7. 30., 2022. 1. 18., 2022. 5. 31., 2023. 2. 28., 2023. 9. 12., 2023. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 34 (Personnel Quota of Public Officials in the Korea Coast Guard) ① The personnel quota by rank for public officials in the Korea Coast Guard isas set forth in Table 4. However, pursuant to the proviso to Article 35, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Korea Coast Guard and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the personnel quota by rank for public officials determined separately within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total personnel quotais as set forth in Table 4-2 , and 26 of the personnel quota in Table 4-2 (3 at Grade 6, 6 at Grade 7, and 17 at Grade 9) shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Aug. 19, 2019; Feb. 4, 2020; Jul. 21, 2020; Oct. 8, 2020; Jul. 30, 2021; Jan. 18, 2022; May 31, 2022; Feb. 28, 2023; Sep. 12, 2023; Dec. 29, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 해양경찰청에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 17명(4급 또는 총경 1명, 5급 또는 경정 3명, 6급 또는 경감ㆍ경위 5명, 7급 또는 경사 5명, 8급 또는 경장 3명)의 범위에서 필요한 인원을 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Within the quota of 17 public officials in the Korea Coast Guard (1 person of Grade 4 or Superintendent, 3 people of Grade 5 or Senior Superintendent, 5 people of Grade 6 or Inspector or Senior Inspector, 5 people of Grade 7 or Senior Inspector, and 3 people of Grade 8 or Senior Inspector), the necessary number of personnel may be appointed as fixed-term public officials.

rows.source_ko: ③ 해양경찰청에 두는 공무원 정원 중 공공데이터 관련 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명) 및 디지털 홍보 업무를 담당하는 2명(4급 또는 5급 1명, 6급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <신설 2019. 2. 26., 2025. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ Among the authorized number of public officials in the Korea Coast Guard, one person (Grade 5) responsible for public data-related duties and two people (one Grade 4 or 5, and one Grade 6) responsible for digital public relations duties shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Newly added Feb. 26, 2019; Dec. 31, 2025>
Article 35 Deleted <September 12, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제36조(소속기관에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 해양경찰교육원에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 5와 같다. 다만, 「해양경찰청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제36조제1항 단서에 따라 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 5의2와 같으며, 별표 5의2의 정원 중 1명(8급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <개정 2018. 9. 5., 2020. 2. 4., 2020. 10. 8., 2022. 1. 18., 2023. 6. 1., 2023. 9. 12., 2024. 9. 26., 2025. 5. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 36 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in Affiliated Agencies) ① The personnel quota by rank for public officials in the Korea Coast Guard Training Institute shall be as set forth in Attached Table 5. However,the personnel quota by rank for public officials separately determined within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total personnel quota pursuant to the proviso to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Korea Coast Guard and Its Affiliated Agencies” shall be as set forth in Attached Table 5-2 , and one person (one person of Grade 8) among the personnel quota set forth in Attached Table 5-2 shall be appointed as a fixed-term public official. <Amended Sep. 5, 2018; Feb. 4, 2020; Oct. 8, 2020; Jan. 18, 2022; Jun. 1, 2023; Sep. 12, 2023; Sep. 26, 2024; May 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항 본문에 따라 해양경찰교육원에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 4명(5급 또는 연구관 1명, 7급 1명, 9급 2명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <신설 2018. 9. 5., 2019. 12. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② Four of the authorized number of public officials at the Korea Coast Guard Training Institute pursuant to the main text of Paragraph 1 (one Grade 5 or Research Officer, one Grade 7, and two Grade 9) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Newly added Sep. 5, 2018; Dec. 2, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ③ 중앙해양특수구조단에 두는 공무원의 정원은 별표 6와 같다. <개정 2018. 9. 5.>
rows.text_en: ③ The authorized number of public officials in the Central Maritime Special Rescue Unit is as set forth in Attached Table 6. <Amended Sep. 5, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ④ 지방해양경찰관서에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 7과 같다. 다만, 「해양경찰청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제36조제1항 단서에 따라 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 7의2와 같으며, 별표 7의2의 정원 중 10명(9급 9명, 연구사 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <개정 2020. 2. 4., 2020. 7. 21., 2020. 10. 8., 2022. 1. 18., 2023. 2. 28., 2023. 6. 1., 2023. 9. 12., 2023. 12. 29.>

However, the authorized number of public officials by rank separately determined within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total authorized number pursuant to the proviso of Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the "Organizational Structure of the Korea Coast Guard and Its Affiliated Agencies" shall be as set forth in Attached Table 7-2 , and among the authorized number set forth in Attached Table 7-2 , 10 persons (9 persons of Grade 9 and 1 Researcher) shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Feb. 4, 2020; Jul. 21, 2020; Oct. 8, 2020; Jan. 18, 2022; Feb. 28, 2023; Jun. 1, 2023; Sep. 12, 2023; Dec. 29, 2023>

rows.text_en: ⑤ Among the authorized number of public officials assigned to regional maritime police stations pursuant to the main text of Paragraph 4, 36 positions (36 Grade 9 positions) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Sep. 5, 2018; Feb. 4, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 정비창에 두는 공무원의 종류별 정원은 별표 8과 같다. <개정 2018. 9. 5.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The authorized number of public officials by type stationed at maintenance depots is as set forth in Attached Table 8. <Amended Sep. 5, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 제37조(시간선택제채용공무원 정원의 운영) 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제24조제3항 및 「공무원임용령」 제3조의3제1항에 따라 해양경찰청과 그 소속기관에 두는 시간선택제채용공무원 정원은 해양경찰청과 그 소속기관에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 일부를 활용하여 운영할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 37 (Operation of Quotas for Part-time Public Officials) Pursuant to Article 24 , Paragraph 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Quotas of Administrative Agencies” and Article 3-3, Paragraph 1 of the “Public Officials Appointment Decree,” the quota for part-time public officials to be established in the Korea Coast Guard and its affiliated agencies may be operated by utilizing a portion of the quota for public officials to be established in the Korea Coast Guard and its affiliated agencies.
[Wholly Amended Oct. 8, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 부칙 제4조에 따라 개정되는 부령 중 이 규칙 시행 전에 공포되었으나 시행일이 도래하지 아니한 총리령을 개정한 부분은 각각 해당 총리령 또는 부령의 시행일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, among the Ministerial Ordinances amended pursuant to Article 4 of the Addenda, the parts amending Prime Ministerial Ordinances that were promulgated prior to the enforcement of this Rule but whose effective date has not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of the said Prime Ministerial Ordinances or Ministerial Ordinances.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(기능 이관에 따른 공무원의 이체) ① 해양에서의 경비ㆍ안전ㆍ오염방제 및 해상에서 발생한 사건의 수사에 관한 사무 이관 등에 따라 이 영 시행 당시 국민안전처 공무원 9,422명(치안총감 1명, 치안정감 2명, 치안감 4명, 경무관 7명, 총경 50명, 경정 201명, 경감 510명, 경위 879명, 경사 1,693명, 경장 2,297명, 순경 2,697명, 고위공무원단 2명, 3ㆍ4급 1명, 4급 7명, 4급 또는 총경 1명, 4ㆍ5급 8명, 5급 63명, 6급 168명, 7급 293명, 8급 320명, 9급 121명, 연구사 5명, 전문경력관 3명, 관리운영 6급 2명, 관리운영 7급 9명, 관리운영 8급 15명, 관리운영 9급 60명, 시간선택제채용공무원 9급 3명)은 해양경찰청 소속 공무원으로 보아 국민안전처에서 해양경찰청으로 이체한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transfer of Public Officials Following Transfer of Functions)  ① Pursuant to the transfer of affairs concerning maritime security, safety, pollution control, and investigation of incidents occurring at sea, etc., at the time of the enforcement of this Decree, 9,422 public officials of the Ministry of Public Safety and Security (1 Commissioner General, 2 Senior Commissioners, 4 Commissioners, 7 Superintendents, 50 Senior Superintendents, 201 Chief Inspectors, 510 Inspectors, 879 Inspectors, 1,693 Senior Inspectors, 2,297 Senior Police Officers, 2,697 Constables, 2 Senior Civil Service Members, 1 Person of Grade 3 or 4, 7 Persons of Grade 4, 1 Person of Grade 4 or Senior Superintendent, 8 Persons of Grade 4 or 5, 63 Persons of Grade 5, 168 Persons of Grade 6, 293 Persons of Grade 7, 320 Persons of Grade 8, 121 Persons of Grade 9, 5 Researchers, Professional Career Officers 3 people, 2 people in Grade 6 of Management and Operations, 9 people in Grade 7 of Management and Operations, 15 people in Grade 8 of Management and Operations, 60 people in Grade 9 of Management and Operations, and 3 people in Grade 9 of part-time employment are considered to be public officials belonging to the Korea Coast Guard and are transferred from the Ministry of Public Safety and Security to the Korea Coast Guard.

rows.source_ko: ② 육지에서의 해양 관련 수사 및 정보 수집 등에 관한 사무의 이관에 따라 이 영 시행 당시 경찰청 소속 공무원 505명(총경 5명, 경정 17명, 경감 31명, 경위 62명, 경사 168명, 경장 179명, 순경 40명, 8급 3명)은 해양경찰청 소속 공무원으로 보아 이를 해양경찰청으로 이체한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with the transfer of duties regarding maritime-related investigations and information collection, etc. on land, 505 public officials belonging to the National Police Agency at the time of the enforcement of this Decree (5 Superintendents, 17 Senior Superintendents, 31 Inspectors, 62 Lieutenants, 168 Senior Inspectors, 179 Senior Police Officers, 40 Constables, and 3 Grade 8 officials) shall be deemed to be public officials belonging to the Korea Coast Guard and shall be transferred to the Korea Coast Guard.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 운영되는 태안ㆍ완도ㆍ울산ㆍ포항ㆍ속초해양경찰서 장비관리운영팀은 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속한다. <개정 2019. 12. 2., 2021. 2. 25., 2021. 11. 23., 2023. 12. 29., 2025. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Equipment Management and Operation Teams of the Taean, Wando, Ulsan, Pohang, and Sokcho Coast Guard Stations, which are operated pursuant to the enforcement of this Rule under Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies, shall remain in existence until December 31, 2027. <Amended Dec. 2, 2019; Feb. 25, 2021; Nov. 23, 2021; Dec. 29, 2023; Dec. 31, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 태안ㆍ완도ㆍ울산ㆍ포항ㆍ속초해양경찰서 장비관리운영팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 해당 해양경찰서 기획운영과장이 각각 분장한다. <개정 2021. 2. 25., 2021. 11. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② Unless special provisions are established regarding matters assigned by the Equipment Management and Operations Team Leaders of the Taean, Wando, Ulsan, Pohang, and Sokcho Coast Guard Stations until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the Head of the Planning and Operations Division of the respective Coast Guard Station shall assign these matters respectively from the day following the expiration of the expiration date under Paragraph 1. <Amended Feb. 25, 2021; Nov. 23, 2021>
[Title amended Nov. 23, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(다른 법령의 개정) ① 국민안전처 소속 경찰공무원 복제에 관한 규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① The Rules on Uniforms for Police Officers Belonging to the Ministry of Public Safety and Security are partially amended as follows:

rows.source_ko: 제명 “국민안전처 소속 경찰공무원 복제에 관한 규칙”을 “해양경찰청 소속 경찰공무원 복제에 관한 규칙”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: The title “Rules on Uniforms for Police Officers Belonging to the Ministry of Public Safety and Security” shall be changed to “Rules on Uniforms for Police Officers Belonging to the Korea Coast Guard”.

rows.source_ko: 제1조 및 제2조제1항 중 “국민안전처 및 그 소속기관”을 각각 “해양경찰청 및 그 소속기관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 1 and Article 2, Paragraph 1, “Ministry of Public Safety and Security and its affiliated agencies” shall be changed to “Korea Coast Guard and its affiliated agencies”.

rows.source_ko: 제2조제1항ㆍ제2항, 제12조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 단서, 같은 조 제5항, 제13조제3항, 제17조제1항, 제18조제1항ㆍ제2항 및 제19조 중 “국민안전처 소속 경찰공무원”을 각각 “해양경찰청 소속 경찰공무원”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 2, Paragraphs 1 and 2; the proviso to the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 12, Paragraph 1; Paragraph 5 of the same article; Article 13, Paragraph 3; Article 17, Paragraph 1; Article 18, Paragraphs 1 and 2; and Article 19, “police officers belonging to the Ministry of Public Safety and Security” shall be changed to “police officers belonging to the Korea Coast Guard.”

rows.source_ko: 제3조, 제8조 각 호 외의 부분 단서, 제15조제2항제3호, 제17조제2항 및 제19조 중 “국민안전처장관”을 각각 “해양경찰청장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 3, the proviso to the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 8, Article 15, paragraph 2, subparagraph 3, Article 17, paragraph 2, and Article 19, “Minister of Public Safety and Security” shall be changed to “Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard”.

rows.source_ko: 제12조제1항 단서 중 “해양경비안전기관(국민안전처와「국민안전처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제2조에 따른 소속기관을 말한다)”을 “해양경찰기관(해양경찰청과 「해양경찰청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제2조에 따른 소속기관을 말한다)”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the proviso to Article 12, Paragraph 1, “maritime security and safety agencies (referring to the Ministry of Public Safety and Security and affiliated agencies pursuant to Article 2 of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Public Safety and Security and its affiliated agencies)” shall be changed to “maritime police agencies (referring to the Korea Coast Guard and affiliated agencies pursuant to Article 2 of the Organizational Structure of the Korea Coast Guard and its affiliated agencies).”

rows.source_ko: ② 국민안전처 소속 경찰공무원 승진임용규정 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on Promotion and Appointment of Police Officers under the Ministry of Public Safety and Security are partially amended as follows:

rows.source_ko: 제명 “국민안전처 소속 경찰공무원 승진임용규정 시행규칙”을 “해양경찰청 소속 경찰공무원 승진임용규정 시행규칙”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: The title “Enforcement Rules for the Promotion and Appointment Regulations of Police Officers under the Ministry of Public Safety and Security” shall be changed to “Enforcement Rules for the Promotion and Appointment Regulations of Police Officers under the Korea Coast Guard.”

rows.source_ko: 제1조, 제3조제1항, 제15조제1항 및 제24조제1항 중 “국민안전처”를 “해양경찰청”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 1, Article 3 Paragraph 1, Article 15 Paragraph 1, and Article 24 Paragraph 1, “Ministry of Public Safety and Security” shall be changed to “Korea Coast Guard.”

rows.source_ko: 제2조제1항, 제6조제1항 단서, 같은 조 제2항, 제17조제1항 본문, 제24조제1항, 제25조제1항 본문, 제28조제2항, 제30조, 제31조 각 호 외의 부분, 제35조제1항 전단ㆍ후단, 같은 조 제3항 각 호 외의 부분 및 같은 조 제4항 중 “국민안전처장관”을 각각 “해양경찰청장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 2, Paragraph 1; the proviso to Article 6, Paragraph 1; Paragraph 2 of the same article; the main text of Article 17, Paragraph 1; Article 24, Paragraph 1; the main text of Article 25, Paragraph 1; Article 28, Paragraph 2; Article 30; the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 31; the first and second parts of Article 35, Paragraph 1; the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 35, Paragraph 3; and Paragraph 4 of the same article, “Minister of Public Safety and Security” shall be replaced with “Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard.”

rows.source_ko: 제2조제2항을 다음과 같이 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2, Paragraph 2 shall be as follows.

rows.source_ko: ② 해양경찰청장은 영 제4조제3항에 따라 영 제37조제1항제2호 및 제3항의 사유로 경감 이하 계급으로 특별승진임용 예정 인원을 따로 책정한 때에는 경찰공무원의 특별승진임용 예정 인원을 해양경찰교육원, 중앙해양특수구조단, 지방해양경찰청 및 해양경찰정비창의 장에게 각각 통지하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard has separately determined the number of officers scheduled for special promotion to the rank of Inspector or lower due to the reasons specified in Article 37, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 and Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall notify the heads of the Korea Coast Guard Training Center, the Central Maritime Special Rescue Unit, the Regional Coast Guard Headquarters, and the Korea Coast Guard Maintenance Depot, respectively, of the number of police officers scheduled for special promotion.

rows.source_ko: 제16조를 다음과 같이 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 shall be as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제16조(근무성적 평정표 등의 제출 등) ① 해양경찰교육원ㆍ해양경찰연구센터ㆍ중앙해양특수구조단ㆍ지방해양경찰청ㆍ해양경찰서 및 해양경찰정비창(이하 “소속기관등”이라 한다)의 장은 소속 경찰공무원에 대한 근무성적 평정표 및 경력 평정표를 평정일부터 20일 이내에 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Submission of Performance Evaluation Sheets, etc.) ① The heads of the Korea Coast Guard Training Center, Korea Coast Guard Research Center, Central Maritime Special Rescue Unit, Regional Korea Coast Guard Headquarters, Korea Coast Guard Stations, and Korea Coast Guard Maintenance Depots (hereinafter referred to as “affiliated agencies, etc.”) shall submit performance evaluation sheets and career evaluation sheets for police officers under their jurisdiction within 20 days from the date of evaluation, in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양경찰교육원(해양경찰연구센터를 포함한다)ㆍ지방해양경찰청(해양경찰서를 포함한다) 및 해양경찰정비창 소속 경감 이상 경찰공무원, 중앙해양특수구조단 소속 경위 이상 경찰공무원: 해양경찰청장
rows.text_en: 1. Police officers of the rank of Inspector or higher belonging to the Korea Coast Guard Training Center (including the Korea Coast Guard Research Center), Regional Coast Guard Headquarters (including Coast Guard Stations), and Korea Coast Guard Maintenance Depot; and police officers of the rank of Inspector or higher belonging to the Central Maritime Special Rescue Unit: Commissioner General of the Korea Coast Guard

rows.source_ko: 2. 해양경찰연구센터 소속 경위 이상 경찰공무원: 해양경찰교육원장
rows.text_en: 2. Police officers of the rank of Inspector or higher belonging to the Korea Coast Guard Research Center: Director of the Korea Coast Guard Training Center

rows.source_ko: 3. 해양경찰서 소속 경위 이상 경찰공무원: 지방해양경찰청장
rows.text_en: 3. Police officers of the rank of Inspector or higher belonging to a Coast Guard Station: Head of the Regional Coast Guard Agency

rows.source_ko: ② 해양경찰청장 및 소속기관등의 장은 평정대상자의 요구가 있는 때에는 경력 평정 결과를 본인에게 알려주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard and the heads of affiliated agencies, etc., shall notify the person subject to evaluation of the career evaluation results upon request.

rows.source_ko: 제20조를 다음과 같이 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 shall be as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제20조(승진대상자 명부의 제출) 해양경찰연구센터장ㆍ중앙해양특수구조단장 또는 해양경찰서장은 「해양경찰청 소속 경찰공무원 임용에 관한 규정」 제8조제3항에 따라 승진심사가 있는 때에는 소속 경찰공무원 중 경사 이하 계급의 승진대상자 명부 사본을 해양경찰청장, 해양경찰교육원장 또는 지방해양경찰청장에게 승진심사예정일부터 25일 이내에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Submission of List of Candidates for Promotion) When there is a promotion review pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 3 of the "Regulations on the Appointment of Police Officers Belonging to the Korea Coast Guard," the Director of the Korea Coast Guard Research Center, the Director of the Central Maritime Special Rescue Team, or the Director of a Coast Guard Station shall submit a copy of the list of candidates for promotion among police officers belonging to the Coast Guard who are at the rank of Sergeant or lower to the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard, the Director of the Korea Coast Guard Training Center, or the Director of a Regional Coast Guard within 25 days from the scheduled date of the promotion review.

rows.text_en: Article 36 shall be as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제36조(경사이하 경찰공무원의 특별승진심사) ① 영 제41조제1항 단서에 따른 경사 이하 경찰공무원의 특별승진심사는 해양경찰청ㆍ해양경찰교육원ㆍ지방해양경찰청 또는 해양경찰정비창 보통승진심사위원회에서 행한다. 다만, 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 중앙승진심사위원회에서 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 36 (Special Promotion Examination for Police Officers of the Rank of Sergeant or Lower) ① The special promotion examination for police officers of the rank of Sergeant or lower pursuant to the proviso to Article 41, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be conducted by the Ordinary Promotion Examination Committee of the Korea Coast Guard, the Korea Coast Guard Training Institute, regional Korea Coast Guard offices, or the Korea Coast Guard Maintenance Depot. However, in any of the cases falling under any of the following subparagraphs, it shall be conducted by the Central Promotion Examination Committee.

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양경찰청장이 특별승진을 공약한 사항에 관하여 공을 세운 자에 대한 특별승진임용의 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of special promotion appointment for a person who has distinguished themselves in relation to a matter for which the Commissioner General of the Korea Coast Guard pledged special promotion

rows.source_ko: 2. 해양경찰청장이 연례적으로 행하는 유공자의 특별승진임용의 경우
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of special promotion appointments of persons of merit conducted annually by the Commissioner General of the Korea Coast Guard

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 해양경찰청장이 중앙승진심사위원회의 심사를 거쳐 특별승진임용을 하기로 결정한 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Other cases where the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard decides to grant a special promotion following a review by the Central Promotion Review Committee

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항 본문에 따른 보통승진심사위원회의 의결방법 및 결과보고에 관하여는 제35조제2항 및 제3항을 준용한다. 이 경우 제35조제3항에 따른 “해양경창청장”은 “해양경찰청장ㆍ해양경찰교육원장ㆍ지방해양경찰청장 또는 해양경찰정비창장”으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② Paragraphs 2 and 3 of Article 35 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the method of resolution and reporting of results of the Ordinary Promotion Review Committee pursuant to the main text of Paragraph 1. In this case, the “Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard” pursuant to Article 35 Paragraph 3 shall be deemed to be the “Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard, Director of the Korea Coast Guard Training Institute, Director of a Regional Korea Coast Guard Agency, or Director of the Korea Coast Guard Maintenance Depot.”

rows.source_ko: 제2조(해양경찰청 소속기관 정원에 관한 특례) ① 제36조제4항 본문에 따라 지방해양경찰관서에 두는 공무원의 정원에 관하여는 별표 7의 개정규정에도 불구하고 2025년 3월 30일까지는 별표 7의3의 개정규정을 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special Provisions Concerning the Personnel Quota of Agencies Under the Korea Coast Guard)  ① Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 7, regarding the personnel quota of public officials assigned to local Coast Guard stations pursuant to the main text of Article 36, Paragraph 4, the amended provisions of Annex 7-3 shall apply until March 30, 2025.

rows.source_ko: ② 제36조제4항 단서에 따라 지방해양경찰관서에 두는 공무원의 정원에 관하여는 별표 7의2의 개정규정에도 불구하고 2025년 3월 30일까지는 별표 7의4의 개정규정을 적용한다.
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Table 7-2, regarding the number of public officials assigned to local maritime police stations pursuant to the proviso of Article 36, Paragraph 4, the amended provisions of Table 7-4 shall apply until March 30, 2025.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 738, May 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 2025년 7월 1일부터 시행한다. 다만, 해양수산부령 제547호 해양경찰청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제2조제2항의 개정규정은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall enter into force on July 1, 2025. However, the amended provisions of Article 2, Paragraph 2 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rule on the Organization of the Korea Coast Guard and Its Affiliated Agencies, Decree No. 547 of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, shall enter into force on the date of promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 758, Sep. 23, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 779, Dec. 31, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2026년 1월 1일부터 시행한다. 다만, 해양수산부령 제250호 해양경찰청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제3조제1항, 해양수산부령 제473호 해양경찰청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제2조제1항, 해양수산부령 제547호 해양경찰청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제2조제2항 및 해양수산부령 제646호 해양경찰청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제2조제3항ㆍ제3조의 개정규정은 2025년 12월 31일부터 시행하고, 별표 1의 개정규정은 2026년 3월 31일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on January 1, 2026. However, the amended provisions of Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Addendum to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Korea Coast Guard and Its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 250), Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the Addendum to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Korea Coast Guard and Its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 473), Article 2, Paragraph 2 of the Addendum to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Korea Coast Guard and Its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 547), and Article 2, Paragraph 3 and Article 3 of the Addendum to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Korea Coast Guard and Its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 646) shall enter into force on December 31, 2025, and the amended provisions of Annex 1 shall enter into force on March 31, 2026.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(해양경찰청 소속기관 정원에 관한 특례) 제36조제3항에 따라 중앙해양특수구조단에 두는 공무원의 정원에 관하여는 별표 6의 개정규정에도 불구하고 2026년 3월 30일까지는 별표 6의2의 개정규정을 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding the personnel quota of agencies under the Korea Coast Guard)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 6 regarding the personnel quota of public officials to be placed in the Central Maritime Special Rescue Group pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 3, the amended provisions of Annex 6-2 shall apply until March 30, 2026.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 디지털소통팀장, 해양경찰연구센터 해양치안과학정책팀 및 강릉해양경찰서 장비관리운영팀은 2028년 12월 31일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Digital Communication Team Leader, the Maritime Security Science Policy Team of the Korea Coast Guard Research Center, and the Equipment Management and Operation Team of the Gangneung Coast Guard Station, which are newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies,” shall remain in existence until December 31, 2028.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 디지털소통팀장이 청장을 보좌하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 디지털소통팀장이 보좌하는 사항은 대변인이 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ② Unless special provisions are made regarding matters in which the Head of the Digital Communication Team assists the Commissioner until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the Spokesperson shall assist in such matters from the day following the expiration of the expiration date under Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 해양경찰연구센터 해양치안과학정책팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 해양경찰연구센터 해양치안과학정책팀장이 분장하는 사항은 해양경찰연구센터 장비연구팀장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If no special provisions are made regarding the matters assigned by the Head of the Maritime Security Science Policy Team at the Korea Coast Guard Research Center until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the matters assigned by the Head of the Maritime Security Science Policy Team at the Korea Coast Guard Research Center shall be assigned by the Head of the Equipment Research Team at the Korea Coast Guard Research Center from the day after the expiration date under Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 강릉해양경찰서 장비관리운영팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 강릉해양경찰서 장비운영관리팀장이 분장하는 사항은 강릉해양경찰서 기획운영과장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ If no special provisions are made regarding the matters assigned by the Head of the Equipment Management and Operations Team of the Gangneung Coast Guard Station until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the matters assigned by the Head of the Equipment Operations and Management Team of the Gangneung Coast Guard Station shall be assigned by the Head of the Planning and Operations Division of the Gangneung Coast Guard Station from the day after the expiration date under Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 4의2의 정원 2명(경정 1명, 경감 1명)은 2028년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2029년 1월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 4의2의 정원 2명(경감 1명, 경위 1명)으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Duration of Positions Upgraded to Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The quota of 2 positions (1 Superintendent and 1 Senior Inspector) specified in Annex 4-2, which is upgraded in rank due to the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until December 31, 2028, and from January 1, 2029, the corresponding quota shall be deemed to be the quota of 2 positions (1 Senior Inspector and 1 Inspector) specified in Annex 4-2.

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 7의2의 정원 1명(경정 1명)은 2028년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2029년 1월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 7의2의 정원 1명(경감 1명)으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The quota of 1 person (1 Superintendent) in Table 7-2, whose rank is adjusted upward due to the enforcement of this rule, shall remain in effect until December 31, 2028, and after January 1, 2029, the corresponding quota shall be 1 person (1 Senior Inspector) in Table 7-2.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 789, Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 별표 6의 개정규정은 2026년 3월 31일부터 시행하고, 제7조, 제17조제6항, 제26조 및 제27조의 개정규정은 2026년 4월 23일부터 시행한다.

However, the amended provisions of Annex 6 shall enter into force on March 31, 2026, and the amended provisions of Article 7, Article 17 Paragraph 6, Article 26, and Article 27 shall enter into force on April 23, 2026.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(지방해양경찰관서 공무원 정원에 관한 특례) 지방해양경찰관서에 두는 공무원의 정원에 관하여는 별표 7 및 별표 7의2의 개정규정에도 불구하고 2026년 3월 30일까지는 별표 7의3 및 별표 7의4의 개정규정을 적용하고, 2026년 3월 31일부터 2026년 4월 22일까지는 별표 7의5 및 별표 7의6의 개정규정을 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding the number of public officials in local maritime police stations)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 7 and Annex 7-2 regarding the number of public officials in local maritime police stations, the amended provisions of Annex 7-3 and Annex 7-4 shall apply until March 30, 2026, and the amended provisions of Annex 7-5 and Annex 7-6 shall apply from March 31, 2026 to April 22, 2026.
